classification: Posthoc new analysis of 16 previously inspected and accepted Synth Bass 1 H1 curves; not an independent recording/holdout, a PM method or a production DSP correction.
chronology: Source hash, all 16 pitch labels, their level ranges and prior whole-window slope grouping were inspected before this design. This protocol is frozen before new crossing or local slope extraction. No PCM is read, decoded, resampled, downloaded or rendered.
source_rows: posthoc_harmonic_result.rows; all 16, preserve original source absolute times and h1_dbfs. No new note/pitch/window selection or frequency fit.
grouping: Already observed grouping: low pitches36..58 (8 rows) and high pitches60..82 (8 rows), not a newly optimized threshold or hardware rate-key-scaling claim.
curve_validation: Every row must contain 81 finite time/level pairs with strictly increasing 5ms times (maximum step deviation1e-10seconds). Do not repair, smooth, sort or truncate malformed curves.
crossing_rule: Find every segment that strictly straddles the target in either direction and every exact-equality sample. Strict straddles exclude equality at endpoints. More than one event is ambiguous and fails. Two or more adjacent equality samples are a plateau and fail. Exactly one event must be downward; an equality event must have neighbors strictly above/below. Never select first/best crossing or monotonize a curve.
crossing_interpolation: For one strict downward straddle, linear interpolation between that original pair gives crossing time. For one qualifying exact-equality sample use its original time. No extrapolation or local time fit.
slope_estimator: Require the entire fixed crossing-relative neighborhood inside original curve support, else fail. Linearly interpolate the original saved levels at all11 offsets; ordinary least-squares level versus offset gives signed dB/s, intercept, R-squared, max residual and endpoint drop. No adaptive neighborhood or model fit. These are overlapping, filtered capture estimates, not independent samples or a silicon counter.
comparison: For each fixed level preserve all16 results and qualification failures; summarize each group's slope range/median, all64 high-minus-low signed slope differences and high/low decay-speed ratios when all qualified. Do not replace missing rows or pool levels as independent observations. No p-value, confidence interval, new adoption gate or fitted RKS/envelope law.
null: Each intrinsic H1 log amplitude is x_i(t)=a_i-r*t with the SAME constant positive decay rate r; observed H1 level is y_i(t)=G(x_i(t)), with the SAME strictly increasing differentiable time-invariant scalar G across notes. At y=L, x=G^-1(L), so dy/dt=-r*G'(G^-1(L)); each crossing-relative trajectory, and any common finite-window slope functional, is independent of a_i. This is a scalar-H1 null, not all forms of memoryless audio distortion.
null_exclusions: Per-note normalization or level changes after the common mapping
Unknown frequency-dependent downstream gain or filtering
Dynamic compression, gating, hysteresis, effects or changing system state
Different actual patches, rates, gates or effect history
Timbre/FM evolution that prevents H1 amplitude being described by one scalar map of intrinsic H1
Unknown true carrier-envelope versus H1-amplitude relation

synthetic_controls.purpose: Test crossing/interpolation/local-slope behavior on sampled scalar curves only; all numbers are arbitrary fixtures, not hardware parameters.
synthetic_controls.starting_coordinates: For each map, use a_i=inverseG(-20.5)+0.02*i, i=0..15. InverseG uses80 bisections in fixed[-100,100]. No fit to actual source.
synthetic_controls.expected_slope: At each target L, evaluate analytic G(inverseG(L)-32*offset) at the SAME11 slope offsets. This crossing-relative finite-window slope is independent of note offset. Compare against all16 sampled/interpolated control estimates.
synthetic_controls.qualification: All240 map/start/level controls must qualify; maximum absolute sampled-versus-analytic finite-window slope discrepancy and within-level between-start slope range each <=0.1dB/s. Failures remain, no gate loosening.
synthetic_controls.separating_control: Identity map with intrinsic rates24.33 for first8 curves and28.46 for last8; same starting-coordinate rule, all5 levels. Each extracted signed slope must match its exact known rate within1e-8dB/s. Not a hardware estimate.

no_adoption: Even a large matched-level discrepancy rejects only the narrow conditional null; no original raw-RKS law, global timing multiplier, threshold or physical DSP constant is adopted. Production, UI, presets, hosts and source media remain unchanged.
